entities.name: HIV-1 Vif
observations: 192 aa viral protein; query matches curated HIV-1 Vif references at 84.9–87.5% identity over 100% length, E-values 1.37e-127 to 2.37e-128.
Predicted molecular weight is 22.57 kDa and theoretical pI is 10.0, consistent with a basic interaction-rich viral accessory protein.
Pfam Vif domain PF00559.24 spans residues 1–192 with i-Evalue 2.4e-106.

entities.name: APOBEC3G
observations: Curated HIV-1 Vif annotations identify APOBEC3G as a host antiviral target whose ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation are promoted by Vif.
Vif can also inhibit APOBEC3G cytidine deaminase activity independently of degradation.

entities.name: APOBEC3F
observations: Curated HIV-1 Vif annotations identify APOBEC3F as a host antiviral target whose ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation are promoted by Vif.

entities.name: Cullin-5 E3 ligase complex
observations: HIV-1 Vif hijacks a host cullin-5-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex with elongin BC and CBFB/CBF-beta to target APOBEC3G and APOBEC3F.

entities.name: Host cytoplasm and membrane
observations: Curated annotations place Vif in the host-cell cytoplasm and on the cytoplasmic side of cellular membranes as a peripheral membrane protein; it is also incorporated into virions.
